claim: An uncrewed Starship departs for Mars
caveat: Mars transfer windows open about every 26 months, so this schedule is quantised: missing late 2026 does not mean early 2027, it means the window after. Running the engine forward is what exposed this -- its first answer was a band containing no launch window at all, which is not a pessimistic prediction but an impossible one. window_months exists because of this claim.

decision.decision: Send an uncrewed Starship to Mars in the 2026 window

requirements.text: Starship must complete orbital propellant transfer first
The vehicle must be ready for the 2026 transfer window
